workLog.action: Aliased DID_NOT_RUN to UNKNOWN in agent_signal and gave the catch-all fallback a diagnostic
workLog.result: verdict.merge_verdicts and check_critical_failures already understood DID_NOT_RUN; the signal gate did not, so an unrecognized token fell through the fallback silently. Aliased it and made the fallback warn.

workLog.action: Moved the fallback warning onto the GitHub annotation channel after an llm-council round
workLog.result: The council's High finding did not survive verification: it held that softening an unrecognized hard-block token to UNKNOWN made it waivable, but verdict.py:71 puts NEEDS_REVIEW in FAIL_VERDICTS and gate_aggregator.py:169 exits 1 on it. Councillors have no file access and inferred waivability from the token name. Its surviving objection was that printing is not surfacing. Searched first and found the repo already uses ::warning:: in 217 places, so the drift warning now uses that prefix and a dedicated test pins it. Negative control: 42 pass with the prefix, exactly 1 fails without it.

workLog.action: Took ownership of the fallback anti-pattern documentation from the sibling branch that could not cite it
workLog.result: On test/vacuous-assertion-anti-pattern the entry cited agent_signal, the DID_NOT_RUN alias, and test_did_not_run_is_aliased_not_merely_caught_by_the_fallback; git grep returned zero hits for all three there. They resolve here because this branch adds them. Re-ran the negative control on this branch to replace a stale count: deleting the alias gives 1 failed and 41 passed, not the 40 an earlier note recorded before a test was added. Neither the orphan-ref validator nor markdownlint catches a dangling symbol or test name; both check file paths only.

patterns.pattern: A fallback that maps every unrecognized state into one bucket hides the states it cannot name.
patterns.context: The gate aggregator mapped a missing external signal onto the same verdict as a real failure, so a gate that never ran was indistinguishable from a gate that ran and failed.
patterns.application: Added an explicit DID_NOT_RUN alias in external_signal_gate.py and a test proving the alias is reached on its own rather than absorbed by the fallback.

avoidances.antipattern: Quoting a test count measured before the file grew.
avoidances.consequence: The draft documented 1 failed and 40 passed, a number taken when the file held 41 tests, against a file that had since reached 42.
avoidances.correction: Re-ran the negative control against the shipping tree, deleted the alias entry, and recorded the observed 1 failed and 41 passed.
